list.title: New Energy Vehicles (Automotive)
list.desc: Used in SiC MOSFET main drive inverters and OBC AMB substrates. Due to high bending strength and CTE matching silicon, Si3N4 is essential for high-reliability automotive SiC modules.

list.title: PV Inverters & Energy Storage
list.desc: Applied to power module cooling and insulation substrates in PV inverters and PCS. Strict requirements for high reliability and thermal cycling resistance.

list.title: Industrial Drives & Wind Power
list.desc: Used for power module packaging in industrial inverters and wind converters. More cost-sensitive, making our self-developed materials highly advantageous.

list.title: Rail & Aerospace
list.desc: Covers traction converters, aerospace power electronics, and high-end appliances. Smaller volume but higher margin, with strong demand for supply chain security.
